g34-classroom-box.transcriptEn: Teacher: Please put the crayons in that box.
Teacher: The blue box by the window.

g34-classroom-pencil.transcriptEn: Partner: Can you pass me that one?

g34-recess-place.transcriptEn: Partner: Let’s meet there after lunch.
Partner: At the bench beside the playground gate.

g34-recess-time.transcriptEn: Partner: You could not catch this sentence because the bell rang.
Partner: Let’s start the game at one thirty.

g34-recess-rephrase.transcriptEn: You: Let’s do it over there. Partner: I’m not sure what you mean.
Partner: Okay, beside the hopscotch grid.

g56-materials-quantity.transcriptEn: Leader: Please bring some sheets of poster paper tomorrow.

g56-materials-person.transcriptEn: Leader: Minseo has the tape. We still need the markers.
Leader: I will bring two packs of markers.

g56-directions-place.transcriptEn: Guide: After the bank, turn toward the hall.
Guide: The music hall across from the bakery.

g56-directions-sequence.transcriptEn: Guide: Walk past the pharmacy and cross at the second light. Then take the next turn.
Guide: Turn right. The library is the first building on the left.

g56-event-decision.transcriptEn: Partner: We could meet at two in the library, or at three in the art room. I think the second plan works better.
Partner: Yes. Three in the art room is the final plan.
